comparisons.title: Oral Erosions: Histology and DIF Comparison
comparisons.subtitle: A two-specimen strategy distinguishes acantholytic, subepithelial, and interface disease

values.pv: Chronic painful fragile bullae/erosions; widespread oral disease often precedes skin.
values.mmp: Desquamative gingivitis and chronic erosions; ocular/genital/laryngeal/esophageal scarring risk.
values.elp: Bilateral reticular white striae with erythema/erosion; desquamative gingivitis.
values.lupus: Palatal ulcer, lichenoid/discoid plaque or nonspecific erosion in a lupus phenotype.
values.em: Acute hemorrhagic crusted lips and widespread erosions; targetoid skin lesions or drug/infection context.

values.pv: Suprabasilar acantholysis with tombstone basal keratinocytes.
values.mmp: Subepithelial cleft; inflammation varies and may be nonspecific.
values.elp: Lichenoid interface mucositis, basal degeneration, Civatte bodies, sawtooth rete.
values.lupus: Interface mucositis ± deep perivascular/periadnexal inflammation and mucin; overlap with lichenoid disease.
values.em: Interface injury with keratinocyte necrosis; severe epidermal necrosis in SJS/TEN.

values.mmp: Linear IgG, IgA and/or C3 along basement membrane; salt-split/serology refines antigen.
values.elp: Shaggy fibrinogen at BMZ and cytoid bodies; less disease-specific.
values.lupus: Granular IgG/IgM/C3 at BMZ and adnexa may occur; interpret with clinic/serology.
values.em: Usually nonspecific/negative; DIF mainly excludes autoimmune blistering disease.

values.pv: Edge for H&E + perilesional/normal buccal mucosa for DIF.
values.mmp: Edge for H&E + perilesional or normal buccal mucosa for DIF; repeat if high suspicion and first DIF negative.
values.elp: Active edge including white striae for H&E; DIF if autoimmune bullous/lupus differential.
values.lupus: Active lesion for H&E ± separate DIF based on diagnostic question.
values.em: Fresh active lesion for H&E; drug/infection workup and severity assessment.

citations.quote: European MMP guideline recommends direct immunofluorescence with serology and interdisciplinary management for mucosa-predominant disease.

comparisons.title: Oral Ulcer Clinical Differential
comparisons.subtitle: Site, recurrence, healing, and extraoral disease are the highest-yield discriminators

values.ras: Nonkeratinized movable mucosa: labial/buccal mucosa, floor of mouth, ventral tongue, soft palate.
values.behcet: Morphologically aphthous at multiple oral sites; genital ulcers/scars add specificity.
values.sle: Hard/soft palate junction, buccal mucosa or oral discoid/lichenoid plaques; may be painless.
values.ibd: Aphthae; Crohn can add deep linear ulcers, cobblestoning, mucosal tags and lip swelling.
values.hsv: Recurrent disease favors keratinized mucosa/hard palate and attached gingiva; grouped vesicles precede erosions.
values.scc: Any site, especially lateral/ventral tongue and floor of mouth; solitary persistent indurated lesion.

values.ras: Recurrent, complete healing; minor lesions 7–14 days, major longer and may scar.
values.behcet: Recurrent oral ulcers plus episodic multisystem disease.
values.sle: May track systemic/cutaneous activity or chronic discoid disease.
values.ibd: May precede or accompany intestinal symptoms.
values.hsv: Prodrome, clustered lesions, recurrent in similar location; usually 7–14 days.
values.scc: Progressive/nonhealing >2–3 weeks, bleeding, pain or sensory change.

values.ras: No systemic disease in primary RAS; stress/trauma and family history common.
values.behcet: Genital scars, uveitis/retinal vasculitis, papulopustules, pathergy, thrombosis/aneurysm, neurologic/GI disease.
values.sle: Photosensitivity, arthritis, cytopenias, nephritis, ANA/ENA/complement phenotype.
values.ibd: Diarrhea, blood, abdominal pain, weight loss, perianal disease, anemia.
values.hsv: Vesicles, contagious exposure, immunosuppression; PCR confirms atypical disease.
values.scc: Induration/fixation, cervical nodes, tobacco/alcohol/HPV or chronic inflammatory risk.

values.ras: Clinical; CBC/nutrient/secondary-cause testing only if atypical.
values.behcet: Clinical longitudinal diagnosis; no single diagnostic laboratory test.
values.sle: Systemic clinical evaluation and targeted serology; biopsy if morphology uncertain.
values.ibd: CBC/nutrients/inflammatory and GI evaluation; endoscopy based on symptoms.
